verdict.rationale: Linear's rate-limiting docs publish exact per-auth API limits, leaky-bucket refill, complexity limits, and X-RateLimit headers, so API overage clearly means throttling. Admins can also set workspace-wide and per-user spend limits that reset periodically, but the evidence does not say what happens when automation or agent usage hits those limits. missing for 10: documented behavior when plan automation/Loops/agent limits are exceeded (overage charges vs hard stop), explicit description of the over-limit response (e.g., error/status returned), plan-tier-specific limit documentation, independent corroboration.
